decision_trail.evidence: TipTap CharacterCount is standard extension. AppContextFooter is ideal insertion point. BubbleToolbar already has AI hooks. Focus mode is pure state management.
Word count and focus mode are core writer tools. AI inline actions leverage existing chat API. Keyboard nav brings WCAG compliance.
Word count is low. Focus mode is medium (Zustand + CSS). AI toolbar is medium (wire to existing API). Keyboard nav is medium-high (focus management across dynamic panels).
All frontend-only. Only one new package. Existing Zustand store and chat API provide all needed infrastructure.
TipTap version mismatch is primary risk. Focus mode state conflicts are mitigable. Keyboard nav has standard patterns.
Directly serves Writing Experience & Quality theme. Tight scope. Builds on M4 foundation.

key_risks: Focus mode state conflicts with panel open/close
AI inline action UX during streaming responses
mitigations: Verify package version compatibility before install
Focus mode auto-closes all panels on enter, restores on exit
Use existing streaming patterns from useChatStreaming
